preview.title: Waypoint planner V2
preview.description: Historical rich preview of the original accepted V2 capture. Use the current planner V2 batch for the active evaluation workflow.

topics.title: Waypoint planning
topics.description: Start with the accepted Planner V2 batch, then the 1,000-world paired terrain sweep for the latest development coverage. The relaxed correction budget is an experiment, not the production default. Earlier challenges, diagnostics and clear-route sanity coverage remain separate.

entries.title: Planner V2 · current evaluation batch
entries.description: The default planner evaluation pack: 32 practical cases and 12 additional terrain cases, grouped results, and detailed flight reports with executed waypoint handoffs.

entries.title: Planner V2 · 1,000-world terrain sweep
entries.description: Latest paired development check: the same 1,000 worlds under correction caps 6 and 24. 733 → 748 verified landings, all prior successes preserved; 387 clear direct and 361 blocked-route landings. Distinct unlaunched/airborne/crash markers and planning-cycle summaries separate proposed obstructions from executed flight. Rich plots, handoffs and separate controls/repeats remain intact. Production stays cap 6; not held-out reliability or the accepted benchmark.

entries.title: Planner V2 · intervention timing comparison
entries.description: Frozen 16-case diagnostic comparison: three baseline landings versus six with conflict-relative timing. Four new landings, but random-054 and the existing ridge CLI test regress. Candidate not adopted; previous timing restored. Open random-035 for a gain and random-054 for the lost control.

entries.title: Planner V2 · harder terrain challenge
entries.description: Held-out 100-case development population: 64 initially blocked routes, 21 corrected landings; all 36 clear routes landed. Retains 43 finite planning stops, actual handoffs up to six, three preservation controls and five exact repeats. Not the accepted benchmark.

entries.title: Planner V2 · harder-terrain calibration
entries.description: Separate 24-case recipe calibration: 15 initially blocked routes, six corrected landings and nine clear direct landings. All four global recipes retained unchanged for the independent 100-case challenge; these are not held-out trials.

entries.title: Planner V2 · full random-terrain sweep
entries.description: Preserved clear-route sanity baseline: 100/100 frozen random cases verified landed, all with direct clear routes. Separate controls demonstrate one and three executed handoffs; all five repeats agree. Harder blocked-route coverage and the accepted benchmark remain separate.

entries.title: Planner V2 · comparison-aware terrain recheck
entries.description: Earlier stopped pass on the same 100 frozen worlds. Direct control accepted; corrected control landed with passing proofs but stopped on diagnostic-derived proposal hashes. Zero random flights attempted; preserved history, not the accepted benchmark.

entries.title: Planner V2 · numerical-fix terrain recheck
entries.description: Same 100 frozen procedural worlds. Stopped at the first preservation control on a clearance-only numerical mismatch; zero random flights attempted. Separate from the accepted benchmark and original stopped survey.

entries.title: Planner V2 · procedural terrain survey
entries.description: 100 frozen procedural worlds; four random flights attempted, three verified landings. Stopped on a replay guard error with 96 unattempted; not the accepted benchmark.

entries.title: Waypoint planner V2
entries.description: Historical presentation of the original accepted 32-case V2 capture; not the current evaluation batch. Original reports remain intact.

entries.title: Legacy V1 planner baseline
entries.description: The earlier V1 route-plan scorecard. Saved reports remain readable; its planner execution is retired. Not the active V2 planner evaluation.

entries.title: Ballistic trajectory screening
entries.description: A setup-only analytical study of conservative ballistic candidate construction and screening; it contains no simulated flight outcomes.

entries.title: Direct-flight feasibility and ridge study
entries.description: Controller-neutral analytical probes of direct ballistic candidates and exact powered bridges, with one bounded one-waypoint ridge canary; no simulation.

topics.title: Flight and landing control
topics.description: Browse controller evidence by the flight task: terminal landing, direct transfers, or following authored waypoint routes.

entries.title: Terminal landing
entries.description: Arrival and landing evidence across approach geometry, energy, payload, and reference-error conditions.

entries.title: Direct transfers
entries.description: Point-to-point transfer evidence across route angle, travel radius, and payload without intermediate waypoints.

entries.title: Following authored waypoint routes
entries.description: Pass-through waypoint evidence keeps route-contract and final-touchdown outcomes explicit and separate.

history.title: Intervention timing · diagnostics-only baseline
history.description: Same frozen 16-case subset before the timing change. All flight motion, selection and proofs match the prior challenge, excluding only additive query diagnostics and wall timings. Three landings; thirteen NoClearing stops. Instrumentation retained, not a new reliability sample.

history.title: Harder-terrain calibration · earlier output stop
history.description: First calibration capture retained with seven attempts. An honest NoNominal stop after an off-cadence handoff passed replay but the rich report rejected its final sample. Presentation-only repair followed by a separate complete retry; no old flight was rewritten.
